resources.string: Manage terminal archives, local voice models, and export templates
Download components when needed and remove unused ones to free space. Downloads continue after leaving this page. Downloading a voice model does not change your active voice profile.
Ubuntu installer cache. Open the terminal to install it. Removing this cache keeps your terminal environment, installed software, and personal files.
Terminal environment installed. Its installer cache can be removed separately.
Used to export a web page as a standalone app. Removing this template does not affect previously exported apps.
Remove this component and its partial downloads. You can download it again later. Chat history, voice profiles, and personal terminal files are kept.
This component is in use. Try removing it later.
